name: Reclamation August 2026 Yakima water-supply forecast
known_limitations: The 58% junior-water-right forecast is a modeled seasonal allocation projection based on August 1 conditions. It is not a final delivered-volume accounting, crop-loss estimate, ecosystem outcome, or universal household-water measure.
automation_notes: Preserve forecast date, entitlement class, hydrologic assumptions, and the distinction between projected allocation and delivered water.
factual_nucleus: On August 1, Yakima basin reservoirs were 57% full with 605,000 acre-feet, or 80% of average. Reclamation forecast 100% of entitlements for senior water-right holders and 58% for junior holders for July through September.
